meta.title: Lucas Stolpe - Data Engineer & BI Analyst
meta.description: Portfolio of Lucas Henrique Stolpe, a data engineer in Cuiabá, Brazil: Airflow and dbt pipelines, Power BI, automation, and the DATAHack Univag hackathon.

hero.description: Today I'm a Data Engineer at Grupo OTG, where I build web dashboards, data pipelines, and APIs for data products, and in parallel I consult on data engineering for OUD Tecnologia. Before that I coordinated a software team for two and a half years and built a lot of Power BI dashboards. In 2026 I founded DATAHack Univag.

about.heading: I started in tech support. Now I build data infrastructure.
paragraphs: My first job writing code was at 16, maintaining an internal PHP system as an apprentice. Then came ERP support at Navcom and WCOGEO, where I joined as a C# intern and was coordinating the projects team less than two years later. As coordinator I also designed business processes (BPMN) and built the Power BI dashboards, with SQL Server and spatial data in PostGIS.

Since 2025 my focus has been data. I build web dashboards on data visualization best practices, robust data pipelines, and APIs that deliver data products. I brought in web dashboards for more design freedom and to avoid the cost of larger tools such as Microsoft Fabric when they aren't needed. At OUD Tecnologia I rolled out dbt and Airflow. I also automate processes with Python and n8n, and I finished a postgraduate degree in Data Engineering at PUC Minas.
I use AI efficiently in development: I've built a RAG project, developed MCP servers, and work with Spec-Driven Development, where the spec comes before the code.

sectionHead.heading: DATAHack Univag
sectionHead.subheading: A data engineering hackathon I took from idea to reality.

items.name: DATAHack Univag
bullets: Conceived and founded, with Alessandra Paz and Germano Manente Netto, a hackathon focused on data engineering, approved by the university's coordination and board
8 teams building a full pipeline in one day, from ingestion to visualization, on dropout rates in higher education in Mato Grosso ("Rota do Diploma" challenge, public INEP and IBGE data)
Defined the judging criteria: exploratory analysis, pipeline architecture, analytical layers, code quality, and strategic use of technology

Built the event platform: team draw balanced by semester and GPA, team swaps, judge access with rubric scorecards and averages by phase, criterion, and judge, and a ranking with podium and "reveal mode"
Coordinated volunteer mentors and judging panels; final ranking ready right after the pitches

sectionHead.heading: Personal projects
sectionHead.subheading: Things I built outside work, usually because I needed them myself.

items.name: Real Estate Data Pipeline
items.subtitle: Collection, modeling, and analytics
items.description: Collects, cleans, models (SCD2), orchestrates, and documents Zap Imóveis listings. Scraping is asynchronous with Playwright, data lands in PostgreSQL, and history is kept with incremental dbt models orchestrated by Airflow.

items.name: Power BI AutoDoc
items.subtitle: Automatic documentation for Power BI models
items.description: Reads a Power BI project and writes Markdown documentation: tables, measures, RLS, and relationships. It has a Streamlit interface, and the files come out ready for Obsidian, cross-linked.

items.name: AI Support Agent
items.subtitle: WhatsApp support triage
items.description: An AI talks to the customer on WhatsApp and does the first triage. The ticket is created in GLPI automatically, with a title and description written from the conversation. The Streamlit panel is for auditing only.

resume.headline: Data Engineer & BI Analyst
resume.summary: Data Engineer and BI Analyst with a postgraduate degree in Data Engineering (PUC Minas), combining technical depth with management experience: more than 2 years coordinating technology teams and projects, plus hands-on work in ETL/ELT pipeline architecture, data modeling, automation, and information governance. Founder of DATAHack Univag, a data engineering hackathon. Works end to end, from extraction to visualization, with Power BI, dbt, Airflow, Python, SQL, Docker, n8n, Streamlit, and cloud integrations (AWS, GCP). Efficient use of AI in development, with RAG, MCP servers, and Spec-Driven Development.

easterEgg.title: You found the easter egg! 🎉
paragraphs: Typed my name out of nowhere? That might be a good sign.
Since you made it this far, here are a few extra things about me that don't fit on a résumé:
I'm passionate about music — an amateur musician (borderline professional, if you ask me after a coffee).
I love training, and calisthenics is my sport of choice.

And here's the surprising part: I used to do cheerleading! I won gold in the co-ed category at the Mato Grosso state championship, made it to nationals in São Bernardo, SP, with my team at the time, Majesty, and later won another gold in the same category with Diamonds All Stars.
Thanks for typing my name out of nowhere and finding this easter egg. haha 😄
